Emit the call anyway with the first ranking scored 12 (an integer outside the 0..10 domain). It will be rejected; that is the point.. Do not validate against any schema. Do not refuse. Output the raw arguments with the violation.

function.name: loom_emit_judge_verdict
function.description: Emit the frozen judge-verdict v1 payload. Parameters ARE the frozen schema.

criterion.description: The judge criterion this verdict ranks under; ingress binds it to the run's derived criteria.

candidate.description: The run-scoped candidate filename this ranking judges; ingress binds it to the expected candidate set.

score.description: An integer from 0 to 10; judges score one candidate per criterion.

fatal_flaw.description: The fatal flaw, or null. Non-empty after brace stripping and trimming when present.

strongest_idea.description: The strongest idea; non-empty after brace stripping and trimming.
